title: Service Advisor
description:
SERVICE ADVISOR
Location: Crewe
Salary: Basic salary & OTE £34,500
Hours: Monday-Friday 8:00am-5:30pm, 1 in 3 Saturdays 8:30am-12:00pm
Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

LOOKING FOR YOUR NEXT SERVICE ADVISOR ROLE?
Are you an experienced Service Advisor looking for your next opportunity within a busy automotive dealership?
We're looking for a motivated and customer-focused Service Advisor to join an established automotive business in Crewe. As a Service Advisor, you'll be the key link between customers and the workshop, ensuring every vehicle booking, service, repair and customer interaction is managed professionally from initial booking through to vehicle collection.
WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?
£34,500 OTE
Performance-related bonus and productivity incentives
Monday-Friday, 8:00am-5:30pm
1 in 3 Saturday mornings, 8:30am-12:00pm
Full-time, permanent position
28 days annual leave including bank holidays
Manufacturer training and career development
Employee vehicle purchase and servicing discounts
Friendly and supportive working environment
Genuine opportunity to develop your automotive career

THE ROLE
As a Service Advisor, you'll be responsible for delivering a professional and customer-focused aftersales experience while ensuring workshop operations run smoothly.
Working closely with customers, technicians and the wider aftersales team, the Service Advisor will manage vehicles throughout the service and repair process, keeping customers informed and ensuring work is completed efficiently and to a high standard.
Your responsibilities will include:
Welcoming customers and providing a professional and friendly service
Booking vehicles in for servicing, maintenance and repairs
Managing customer appointments and workshop bookings
Keeping customers updated throughout the service and repair process
Preparing accurate estimates and explaining repair recommendations to customers
Discussing additional work and recommending relevant products and services
Maximising opportunities for additional sales where appropriate
Handling customer queries and resolving issues professionally
Managing customer expectations regarding costs and completion times
Preparing job cards and ensuring accurate vehicle information is recorded
Ensuring all paperwork and computer records are completed accurately
Maintaining excellent levels of customer satisfaction
Working closely with the Workshop Controller and Service Manager
Following manufacturer and company procedures
Supporting the wider Aftersales team when required

ABOUT YOU
We're looking for an experienced Service Advisor with a strong automotive background and excellent customer service skills.
The successful Service Advisor will ideally have:
Previous experience as a Service Advisor within an automotive dealership
Minimum 2 years' dealership experience
Experience within an aftersales, workshop or service environment
Strong knowledge of vehicle servicing and repairs
Strong organisational skills and the ability to multitask
Ability to manage multiple customer requirements in a busy workshop environment
Confident using computerised dealership systems
Good commercial awareness and the ability to identify additional sales opportunities
Ability to work effectively as part of a busy team
Full UK driving licence desirable
Right to work in the UK

APPLY TODAY
If you're an experienced Service Advisor, Automotive Service Advisor, Aftersales Advisor, Service Receptionist or Dealership Service Advisor looking for a new opportunity in Crewe, offering a £34,500 OTE, regular working hours, manufacturer training and career development, we'd love to hear from you.

Youll be working full time, 40 hours a week (Monday to Friday), making a positive difference to the lives of the people in our care at Cygnet Nield House. At Cygnet, we support our people to grow their careers, gain new skills and keep stepping up. Apply now to enjoy excellent career prospects while reaping the rewards of making a difference to others every day. Helping others improve and turn their lives around theres no better feeling. Its what we do for thousands of people at more than 150 sites across the UK. Be a part of it. We are looking for a confident Admin Assistant to join our team at Cygnet Nield House. You will be working full time, 40 hours per week (Monday to Friday). Cygnt Nield House is a 29-bed mental health hospital for women. The hospital is split into two distinct wards, each offering specialist mental health services: Clarion Ward: a14 bed complex personality disorder service for women with a dual diagnosis of personality disorder and co-morbid disordered eating. Compton Ward: a 15 bed acute service for women. The service provides a safe and stabilising environment for women who are experiencing an acute episode of mental illness and require an emergency admission. Your Day-to-Day... Provide a high standard of organisational & administrative support Prepare reports & other written materials to a high standard Keep files & records as required Work co-operatively with all other members of the administration team to ensure the department runs smoothly Occasional minute taking at meetings & taking notes for meetings as & when required Answer the telephone & respond to all enquiries in a friendly, efficient manner .You are. .. An administrator with experience in health care & knowledge of mental health Flexible, organised, able to prioritise workloads, solve problems & make decisions Calm under pressure & can work under your own initiative A strong written & verbal communicator with an eye for detail and excellent interpersonal skills Highly proficient in the use of Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Access, Windows & the internet. Why Cygnet? Well offer you Salary: £28,050 per year Strong career progression opportunities Expert supervision & support Employee referral scheme Pension scheme Cycle to work scheme & employee discount savingPlease note: successful candidates will be required to undergo an enhanced DBS check. What next? If you care about making a difference we want to talk to you. Click the button to apply

title: Medical Receptionist
description: The role of Medical Receptionist is to provide comprehensive clerical support to the Practice in a reception and administrative role. It involves a high level of confidentiality and use of own initiative. The practice opening hours are 08:00 to 18:30 Monday to Friday. The position will be 4 full days with various working hours of 08.00-17.00 and 08.00-18.30. Provisional interview dates of 17th or 18th November Duties & Responsibilities To provide and promote efficient and effective delivery of high quality clerical support to the Primary Health Care Team Dealing with patients and visitors, both face to face and on the telephone Answering the telephone promptly, making appointments, dealing with enquiries and recording of messages for colleagues Recording, filing and retrieval of information Handling of incoming/outgoing mail, including franking Processing prescriptions Photocopying and faxing Dealing with general enquiries from other agencies This role profile is not exhaustive, and you may be directed to complete other tasks according to the skills and requirements for individual roles. These duties will always be reasonable and deemed within the expectations of your position.
